7739.title: Usage refresh failures retain previous readings
7739.rootCauseOneLine: Claude usage HTTP/validation failures return without updating quota, and the hub swallows transport exceptions; the source RPC returns the previous successful reading without warning logs.
7739.proposedFix: Log bounded usage refresh failures with HTTP status, preserve last successful data while exposing freshness/failure, and carry observedAt into Provider Usage's snapshot and UI.
7739.caveats: Disabled-source persistence was not reproduced on current main. No real macOS/provider credit incident or UI screenshot was verified. A complete fix spans plugins and changes the freshness RPC schema, outside the simple-fix limits.
